hero_h1: There is too much flying around. We shut it out.
hero_p: Handmade in Berlin, custom made for everyone. Every Heisenbag Shield piece carries a full Faraday cage woven into the fabric. For your phone, your car, your studio, your home. Nothing to charge, nothing to switch on, no app to trust.
how_h2: A metal cage, woven into cloth.
how_p: The physics is 190 years old and unbeatable. We just made it wearable.
step1: Radio waves are electricity in the air. Every call, every GPS ping, every LTE packet is an electric field looking for your phone's antenna.
step2: A conductive mesh eats electric fields. The lining in every Shield product is a fine silver-metal weave. Incoming waves flow around it, never through it.
step3: What can't get in can't track you. No signal reaches the device, so the device reports nothing: no location, no tower handshake, no data.
step4: No battery, no app, no off-switch to forget. The cage works because of what it is, not what it does. It cannot be updated, hacked, or turned off.
learn_p: Three ideas explain everything we make. Once you see them, you will never look at a phone the same way.
learn1_p: Radio is light you cannot see. Both are the same thing: electric fields rippling through space. Your phone, your wifi, your GPS satellite, the sunlight on the table: one family of waves, different lengths. Nothing mystical, all measurable.
learn2_p: A prism splits one beam into many colors because each wavelength bends differently. Wavelength decides everything: long waves pass through walls, short ones carry data. 5G, LTE and Bluetooth are just colors of radio, and like every color, a wall can stop them.
learn3_p: Your phone and the tower shout at each other constantly, even when you sleep. That two-way shouting is how networks find you, price you and follow you. Wrap the phone in a conductive cage and the shout never arrives. Silence is not a setting. It is geometry.

p_tote: The daily carry. One pocket inside swallows the phone whole.
p_sleeve: For tablet and laptop. Meetings without an audience.

p_weekender: Cabin-sized duffel. Border crossings without a data trail.
p_keyfob: Drops your car key off the air. Relay thieves get silence.
p_wallet: Cards and cash. NFC, RFID and skimmers locked out.
harness_p: Worn, not carried. Three harnesses that keep the phone on your body and off the air until you decide otherwise.

p_hoodie: Kangaroo pocket is a dead zone. Phone in, world out.
p_parka: Deep caged pockets, storm-proof outside, signal-proof inside.
p_cap: Six panels, one hidden pocket. The quiet cap.
p_beanie: Knit outside, silver inside. Winter, untracked.
p_scarf: Wraps the phone you forgot to switch off.

p_tent: Pop-up privacy room for two. Nothing in, nothing out.
p_curtain: One panel, full length. The window stops listening.
p_canopy: Crib canopy. The smallest sleeper, the quietest air.
p_blanket: A throw for the sofa. Devices under it are gone.
p_cone: Tabletop cone for meetings. Phones in, minds present.
p_sleepbox: Bedside box. The phone sleeps before you do.
p_keybox: Entryway box. Every key in the house, off the air.
p_router: A cloche for the wifi. Night mode, enforced by physics.
custom_p: Every piece is handmade and custom made for you. Describe what should be quiet, we draw it in our style right here in the chat, and once you love the drawing, real people sew it and ship it worldwide.
p_carcover: Your car disappears from every network while it sleeps.
p_studio: Recording studios, labs, meeting rooms. Walls that hold their breath.
p_research: Measured attenuation for labs, clinics and anyone who needs certainty.
p_anything: Curtains, covers, garments, enclosures. If you can describe it, we can shield it.
why_h2: Everyone is reachable. Almost no one chooses when.
why_p1: Your phone talks to towers, satellites, beacons and apps around the clock. It does this in your pocket, on your nightstand, in your meetings. Airplane mode is a promise from the same companies that monetize your location. A Faraday cage is not a promise. It is physics.
why_p2: Every Shield piece is handmade, lined with silver-plated polyamide fabric woven in Germany, attenuating 60 dB and more from 200 MHz to 14 GHz: 5G, LTE, GPS, wifi, Bluetooth, NFC. Journalists crossing borders, lawyers in negotiations, recording artists, parents teaching kids what attention feels like: they all need one moment where the device is simply not there.
